theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_sdp_clear_first_row
theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (H : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R), (∀ i : Fin m, H i.succ 0 = 0) → (∀ j : Fin m, H 0 0 ∣ H 0 j.succ) → ∃ V : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R, IsUnit V ∧ H * V = Matrix.of (fun i j => Fin.cases (Fin.cases (H 0 0) (fun _ => 0) j) (fun i' => Fin.cases 0 (fun j' => H i'.succ j'.succ) j) i)
theorems.natural_summary: Choose divisibility coefficients and place them in row zero of M, with column zero and all other rows zero. Then M² = 0, so V = I − M has inverse I + M. Computing H − HM clears the first row while preserving the pivot and trailing block, using the zero first-column hypothesis.
